Hi all,

Thanks Sarah — the W-8BEN-E is a good start. A couple of specific items our tax/legal team needs to complete vendor setup and to validate treaty withholding:

1) Signer authority: the W-8 must be signed by an authorized officer of the entity. If the signature is an agent (e.g., third-party preparer), we need an authorization letter on company letterhead naming the preparer and confirming authority.
2) Proof of residency/management: one of the following: recent bank statement (redacted), VAT registration certificate, or an official director's confirmation.
3) Entity name on PO: please confirm the exact legal name the invoice will show (matching Companies House).
4) W-8 date: the copy we received has a completion date but no explicit printed name block for the signer — can you resend a version that includes printed name and title next to the signature?

If you can return the items above by end of day Thursday (UK time) we'll aim to clear the PO hold and issue PO #82491 by Friday. If any of this requires counsel review, loop us in and we can allow an extra 48 hours.

Karthik — tagging you for tax treaty question: if Satori provides a VAT registration certificate plus an authorization letter, do we need anything else to accept the treaty claim in our AP system?

Thanks,
